payload.name: PostSyncer
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Schedule and publish social media posts from ChatGPT. PostSyncer connects ChatGPT to your Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, X (Twitter), LinkedIn, Facebook, Threads, Bluesky, Pinterest, Telegram and Mastodon accounts - 11 networks from one app.

Ask ChatGPT to write a caption, attach an image or video (including ones it just generated), and post now or schedule it across several networks at once, with per-platform variants. Ask how a post or an account performed and get views, likes, comments and shares back in the chat. Sync and reply to comments, hide spam, group posts into campaigns, and keep a media library - all without opening a dashboard.

Setup is one click: install the app and sign in to PostSyncer. Publishing goes through PostSyncer's official platform integrations, so ChatGPT never sees your social logins.

Try: "@PostSyncer schedule this video to TikTok, Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts for tomorrow at 9am" - "@PostSyncer draft a week of LinkedIn and X posts about our launch and schedule them" - "@PostSyncer which of my posts got the most views this month?"
payload.longDescription:
在 ChatGPT 中安排并发布社交媒体帖子。PostSyncer 可将 ChatGPT 连接到你的 Instagram、TikTok、YouTube、X（Twitter）、LinkedIn、Facebook、Threads、Bluesky、Pinterest、Telegram 和 Mastodon 账户，一个应用即可管理 11 个平台。

让 ChatGPT 撰写配文、附加图片或视频（包括刚刚生成的内容），然后立即发布，或一次性安排到多个平台，并为每个平台生成不同版本。询问帖子或账户的表现，即可在聊天中查看浏览量、点赞、评论和分享数据。同步并回复评论、隐藏垃圾内容、将帖子归入营销活动，还可管理媒体库，全程无需打开控制面板。

只需一步即可完成设置：安装应用并登录 PostSyncer。发布操作通过 PostSyncer 的官方平台集成完成，因此 ChatGPT 不会看到你的社交账户登录信息。

试试这样提问：“@PostSyncer 将这段视频安排到 TikTok、Instagram Reels 和 YouTube Shorts，明天上午 9 点发布”——“@PostSyncer 为我们的发布活动起草一周的 LinkedIn 和 X 帖子并安排发布”——“@PostSyncer 我这个月哪条帖子浏览量最高？”

payload.name: CI HUB
payload.description: 管理你的 DAM 资产
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: CI HUB helps users search and browse connected DAMs, storage providers, images services. Inspect and download files and brand kits, upload and organize assets and folders.
payload.longDescription: CI HUB 帮助用户搜索和浏览已连接的 DAM、存储服务提供商及图像服务。查看并下载文件和品牌素材包，上传并整理资产与文件夹。

payload.name: Storydoc
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Storydoc turns your presentation templates into finished, personalized decks from a conversation. Browse the templates in your Storydoc account, fill their variables to create a new version for a specific client, or generate a brand-new deck from scratch with the AI wizard. Every deck lands in your Storydoc account and comes back as a shareable short URL. You can also ask how your decks are performing and get engagement totals, top stories and versions, and breakdowns by device and location.
payload.longDescription: Storydoc 可以通过对话将演示模板转化为完成度高、个性化的演示文稿。浏览 Storydoc 账户中的模板，为特定客户填写变量并创建新版本，也可以使用 AI 向导从头生成全新的演示文稿。每份演示文稿都会保存到你的 Storydoc 账户，并以可分享的短链接形式返回。你还可以询问演示文稿的表现，获取互动总量、热门故事和版本，以及按设备和地点划分的数据。

payload.name: Aerion
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Aerion helps authenticated users inspect their project, time tracking, staffing, approval, and analytics data from ChatGPT. Users can find and describe Aerion records, create or update permitted records, submit their own time entries, and perform approval workflows when their Aerion permissions allow it.
payload.longDescription: Aerion 帮助经过身份验证的用户通过 ChatGPT 查看项目、工时追踪、人员配置、审批和分析数据。用户可以查找并描述 Aerion 记录、创建或更新获准操作的记录、提交自己的工时条目，并在 Aerion 权限允许时执行审批工作流。

payload.name: Octen
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Octen gives ChatGPT live information from the web through Octen's hosted MCP server: real-time web search with query-relevant highlights and filters, a dedicated news vertical, broad multi-angle search for research and comparisons, clean URL-to-markdown extraction for reading and grounding answers, and (invite-only beta) image and video search. Users connect their Octen account via OAuth; no API key configuration is needed.
payload.longDescription: Octen 通过其托管 MCP 服务器为 ChatGPT 提供实时网络信息：包含查询相关重点和筛选器的实时网页搜索、专门的新闻频道、用于研究和比较的多角度广泛搜索、便于阅读和提供答案依据的网址转 Markdown 提取，以及（仅限受邀用户的 Beta 版）图片和视频搜索。用户通过 OAuth 连接 Octen 账户；无需配置 API 密钥。

payload.name: Native Soil
payload.description: 保存并加载 AI 对话状态
payload.summaryOriginal: Save and load AI chat state
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Native Soil saves the working state of your AI chat (the decisions, the context, and the plan) and lets you load it in any other model, client, or provider. Switch tools, hit a context limit, or come back tomorrow, and pick up where you left off instead of re-explaining everything. Every save is checked and graded before it is stored, secrets and private data are stripped, and nothing in your chat is changed or deleted. On shared projects, loads are measured with a recall check, so you can see what actually carried over and what needs review. Type "soil save" to capture the state, then "soil load" to restore it anywhere.
payload.longDescription: Native Soil 会保存 AI 对话的工作状态（决策、上下文和计划），并让你在任何其他模型、客户端或服务提供商中加载这些内容。切换工具、达到上下文限制，或明天再回来时，你可以从上次中断处继续，无需重新解释所有内容。每次保存都会经过检查和评分，保存前会剔除机密信息和私人数据；聊天内容不会被更改或删除。在共享项目中，加载结果会通过回忆检查进行衡量，让你了解实际恢复了哪些内容，以及哪些需要复核。输入 “soil save” 捕获状态，再输入 “soil load” 即可在任何地方恢复。

payload.name: Rox
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Rox helps users find and analyze authenticated sales data from their Rox workspace, including accounts, deals, contacts, notes, emails, meetings, documents, org charts, and Slack activity. The app exposes a guided data interface: users can discover available data functions, inspect each function's schema and workflow guidance, then invoke read-only functions to answer sales and account intelligence questions.
payload.longDescription: Rox 帮助用户查找和分析其 Rox 工作区中经过身份验证的销售数据，包括客户账户、交易、联系人、备注、电子邮件、会议、文档、组织结构图和 Slack 活动。该应用提供引导式数据界面：用户可以发现可用的数据功能，查看各功能的 schema 和工作流指导，然后调用只读功能来回答销售和客户情报问题。

payload.name: Mallary
payload.description: 在社交媒体发布并回复
payload.summaryOriginal: Post and reply on social media
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Use Mallary in ChatGPT to publish and schedule posts, upload media, read and reply to comments, and check post and audience results across your connected social media accounts.
payload.longDescription: 在 ChatGPT 中使用 Mallary，在你已连接的社交媒体账户上发布和安排帖子、上传媒体、阅读并回复评论，以及查看帖子和受众数据。

payload.name: PlatoForms
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
PlatoForms is an online form builder for web forms, fillable PDF forms and PDF documents. This plugin connects your PlatoForms account so you can work with your own forms and their submissions in conversation, instead of opening the dashboard.

What you can do

• Find forms. List published, draft or archived forms with their folder, publish state and submission count, or search by name.

• Understand a form. Read a form's full field schema — every field's id, type, label, whether it is required, its options and its validation rules — so you can reason about the data before you touch it.

• Review submissions. List a form's submissions newest-first, filter them by date range or keyword, find one by an exact field value (for example the submission where the email field is a particular address), and read every answer of a single submission with its field labels.

• Export. Mint a time-limited download URL for a submission's PDF, CSV, signing certificate, zipped attachments or a single attachment. Files are never streamed through the conversation — you get a link that expires.

• Share a prefilled link. Create one or more tracked invitation links to a form with fields already filled in, optionally single-use, optionally with an expiry. The plugin returns the URLs for you to send; it never sends email itself.

• Submit an entry. Post an entry to a published form after reading its schema, with validation errors returned verbatim so mistakes can be corrected and resubmitted.

• Start something new. Describe a form or a PDF document in plain English and get a builder link back. The design happens in the PlatoForms builder when you open the link, with its own AI asking you the clarifying questions.

How it connects

Sign in with your PlatoForms account over OAuth — your password is never shared with the assistant, access is scoped to read or read-and-write, and you can revoke it at any time from your PlatoForms account. The plugin can only see what your own account can see. A team owner controls whether the team is reachable this way at all, from Account → API.

Requirements

A PlatoForms account on a plan that includes API access. Actions count against your plan's API allowance. Teams in HIPAA mode have this access switched off by default and must opt in explicitly; data sent to a third-party AI assistant is not covered by the PlatoForms Business Associate Agreement.

What the plugin cannot do

It cannot edit an existing form or document, publish, delete, rename or duplicate anything, send email, or configure workflows, integrations or notifications. Those stay in the PlatoForms editor.

payload.name: Planday
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Connect directly to your Planday account to manage scheduling, shifts, and team absences entirely through natural conversation.

Save time and streamline your daily operations by bringing instant workforce insights directly into your workflow. Instead of switching tabs, you can simply ask for what you need: check who is on shift next Saturday, see Anna’s remaining annual leave balance, or instantly verify James’s working-time compliance before booking his next shift. You can draft, assign, and publish shifts individually, or ask ChatGPT to factor in upcoming events to help you quickly coordinate next week's schedule.

Core Capabilities:

Scheduling: View, create, assign, and publish shifts by department, employee, or date.
Employees: Look up staff groups, roles, and department structures.
Absence: Check live leave balances and review policies
Compliance: Check working-time rules on a schedule

Enterprise-Grade Security & Permissions:
Every action respects your existing Planday user permissions. Managers only access manager-level data, while employees only see their own information. No data is surfaced that would not normally be available to you inside the Planday app.

Securely connect via your standard Planday login with zero configuration required.
payload.longDescription:
直接连接您的 Planday 账户，通过自然对话全面管理排班、班次和团队休假。

将即时劳动力信息直接带入工作流，节省时间并简化日常运营。无需切换标签页，只需询问所需信息：查看下周六谁在上班、查看 Anna 剩余的年假天数，或在安排 James 的下一班之前立即核实其工时合规情况。您可以逐个起草、分配和发布班次，也可以让 ChatGPT 考虑即将到来的活动，快速协调下周的日程。

核心功能：

排班：按部门、员工或日期查看、创建、分配和发布班次。
员工：查询员工组、职位和部门结构。
休假：查看实时假期余额并查阅相关政策。
合规：检查排班中的工时规则。

企业级安全与权限：
每项操作都遵循您现有的 Planday 用户权限。经理只能访问经理级别的数据，员工只能查看自己的信息。不会显示您在 Planday 应用中通常无权查看的任何数据。

使用您的标准 Planday 登录信息即可安全连接，无需任何配置。

payload.name: Aphex
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect your AI tool to your construction delivery data in Aphex — ask questions and draft reports grounded in the live site record.
payload.longDescription: 将你的AI工具连接到Aphex中的建筑交付数据，提出问题，并根据施工现场的实时记录起草报告。

payload.name: Thriveworks Jobs
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Thriveworks Jobs helps job seekers explore open roles at Thriveworks. Search by job title, location, or both — the assistant surfaces relevant opportunities and lets you dig into the details before applying. Powered by Appcast.
payload.longDescription: Thriveworks Jobs 帮助求职者探索 Thriveworks 的空缺职位。按职位名称、地点或两者搜索，助手会显示相关机会，并允许你在申请前深入了解详情。由 Appcast 提供支持。

payload.name: GoSearch
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
GoSearch connects your AI assistant to your organization's knowledge base. Ask a question and get answers pulled from the apps your team already uses, like Google Drive, Slack, Jira, Notion, and 100+ more, all in one place.

  Use it two ways:
  - Search across your connected apps to find the document, message, or ticket you need, with links back to the source.
  - Ask GoAI a question and get a written answer grounded in your organization's content, with citations so you can verify where it came from.

  GoSearch respects your existing permissions, so you only see results from content you already have access to.
payload.longDescription:
GoSearch 将 AI 助手连接到组织的知识库。提出问题，即可从团队已在使用的应用中获取答案，例如 Google Drive、Slack、Jira、Notion 等 100 多种工具，所有内容汇集一处。

有两种使用方式：
- 搜索已连接的应用，找到所需的文档、消息或工单，并附上返回来源的链接。
- 向 GoAI 提问，获得基于组织内容撰写的答案，并附有引用，供你核实信息出处。

GoSearch 遵循你现有的权限，因此你只能看到自己已经有权访问的内容。

payload.name: Memocore
payload.description: 持久共享 AI 记忆
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Memocore gives ChatGPT persistent memory that carries across every conversation. Save facts, preferences, projects, and notes once — private to you or shared with a team — and Memocore recalls them automatically whenever they're relevant, so you never repeat context again.
payload.longDescription: Memocore 为 ChatGPT 提供可延续到每次对话中的持久记忆。只需保存一次事实、偏好、项目和笔记（仅供自己使用或与团队共享），Memocore 就会在相关时自动回忆它们，让你不必再重复提供上下文。

payload.name: Snagajob
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Find hourly jobs on Snagajob without leaving the chat. Search by job title, location, or industry and browse listings from employers actively hiring near you. View job details, pay, and shift information, then head to Snagajob to apply when you're ready.

With Snagajob in the conversation, you can:

Search for hourly and part-time jobs near you
Filter by location, industry, and job type
View pay, hours, and employer details
Jump to Snagajob to apply in seconds
Whether you're looking for a first job, a side gig, or a full-time hourly role, Snagajob connects you to opportunities fast.
payload.longDescription:
无需离开聊天，即可在 Snagajob 查找按小时计酬的工作。按职位名称、地点或行业搜索，并浏览附近正在积极招聘的雇主发布的职位。查看职位详情、薪酬和班次信息，准备好后前往 Snagajob 申请。

在对话中使用 Snagajob，你可以：

搜索附近的小时工和兼职工作
按地点、行业和工作类型筛选
查看薪酬、工时和雇主详情
快速跳转到 Snagajob 申请
无论你是在找第一份工作、兼职副业，还是全职小时工岗位，Snagajob 都能帮你快速找到机会。

payload.name: table
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
table connects ChatGPT to your relationship workspace, so you can find contact context when you need it and save new details back to your people intelligence tool.

Use the table connector to look up information about people in table, then create or update contacts from explicit details in conversations, emails, notes, or meeting recaps. ChatGPT can help with fields like name, email, phone, organization, job title, location, birthday, and contact status.

The connector works through table’s secure OAuth flow, acts as the authenticated table user, and exposes focused contact tools instead of raw database access.
payload.longDescription:
table 将 ChatGPT 连接到你的人际关系工作区，让你在需要时查找联系人的背景信息，并将新详情保存回人脉管理工具。

使用 table 连接器查询 table 中的联系人信息，然后根据对话、电子邮件、笔记或会议纪要中的明确详情创建或更新联系人。ChatGPT 可以帮助填写姓名、电子邮件、电话、组织、职位、地点、生日和联系人状态等字段。

此连接器通过 table 的安全 OAuth 流程运行，以已通过身份验证的 table 用户身份进行操作，并提供专用联系人工具，而不是原始数据库访问权限。

payload.name: VaDa Genius
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
VaDa Genius helps you understand the energy in your home using your real energy data.

Ask about your electricity consumption, solar panels, batteries, electricity tariffs, EV charging and opportunities to use energy better. Discover when you consume the most, how much of your consumption happens during solar hours, whether solar panels or a battery could make sense, or whether your existing solar installation is performing as expected.

Genius can work with connected energy sources such as VaDa SmartHouse, supported solar platforms and consumption data, depending on your setup. If VaDa Smart is available, Genius can also explain what is happening in your home in real time and what VaDa is doing.

VaDa Genius is read-only. It can explain, compare, recommend and visualize energy information, but it does not operate electrical equipment, change contracts or replace a certified installer, electrical study, legal advice or guaranteed savings calculation.
payload.longDescription:
VaDa Genius 使用你的实际能源数据，帮助你了解家中的能源情况。

询问用电量、太阳能板、电池、电价、EV 充电以及更高效用能的机会。了解用电高峰时段、太阳能时段内的用电量占比、安装太阳能板或电池是否值得，或现有太阳能系统的表现是否符合预期。

根据你的设备情况，Genius 可以使用已连接的能源来源，例如 VaDa SmartHouse、受支持的太阳能平台和用电数据。如果可以使用 VaDa Smart，Genius 还可以解释家中实时发生的情况以及 VaDa 正在执行的操作。

VaDa Genius 仅提供只读功能。它可以解释、比较、推荐和可视化能源信息，但不会操作电气设备或更改合同，也不能替代认证安装人员、电气评估、法律建议或有保证的节省金额计算。

payload.name: Release Notes Coverage Checker
payload.description: 检查发行说明覆盖情况
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Extract structured release items from user-provided change lists, delivery reports, commit summaries, and test results. Compare those items with user-provided release notes to identify covered, missing, and inconsistently described changes, with source evidence for review. The plugin analyzes only the text supplied in the current request. It does not access repositories, run tests, verify implementation, rewrite release notes, or publish releases.
payload.longDescription: 从用户提供的变更清单、交付报告、提交摘要和测试结果中提取结构化发布事项。将这些事项与用户提供的发行说明进行比较，找出已涵盖、遗漏和描述不一致的变更，并提供来源证据供审查。该插件只分析当前请求中提供的文本，不会访问代码仓库、运行测试、验证实现、改写发行说明或发布版本。

payload.name: Hive
payload.description: 在 ChatGPT 中管理工作
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Hive helps users manage projects, actions, files, messages, CRM records, campaigns, time tracking, dashboards, and workspace automation. It can also use configured integrations such as Salesforce, email, calendar, QuickBooks, MCP servers, and HTTP connections.
payload.longDescription: Hive 帮助用户管理项目、行动事项、文件、消息、CRM 记录、营销活动、时间追踪、仪表板和工作区自动化。它还可以使用已配置的集成，例如 Salesforce、电子邮件、日历、QuickBooks、MCP 服务器和 HTTP 连接。

payload.name: Dovetail Regulatory
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Dovetail Regulatory connects medtech teams to their Dovetail workspace from ChatGPT. Users can inspect devices and tasks, search and edit regulatory documents and data keys, manage traceability links and comments, research standards and FDA 510(k)s, recall project knowledge, and run regulatory research and review agents.
payload.longDescription: Dovetail Regulatory 可让医疗技术团队通过 ChatGPT 连接到自己的 Dovetail 工作区。用户可以检查设备和任务，搜索并编辑法规文档和数据键，管理可追溯性链接和评论，研究标准和 FDA 510(k) 文件，回顾项目知识，并运行法规研究与审查代理。

payload.name: UNC Health Careers
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Discover your next opportunity with the UNC Health Careers ChatGPT app!

UNC Health is an integrated health care system owned by the state of North Carolina and based in Chapel Hill. UNC Health is committed to empowering health, not just health care. From Magnet recognition to being named one of America’s Best Employers by Forbes Magazine, we’re proud to say that our hard work is consistently recognized, awarded, and celebrated.

UNC Health and our more than 56,000 teammates work together to improve the health and well-being of the communities we serve across North Carolina, caring for patients from all 100 counties and beyond our borders. We continue to leverage the world class research conducted in the UNC School of Medicine, translating that innovation to life-saving and life-changing therapies, procedures, and techniques for the patients who rely on us.

Try asking things like:
- Find RN roles in Chapel Hill
- Show me full time CT Technologist jobs with benefits

When you’re ready, click ‘View & Apply’ on ChatGPT, and you’ll go straight to the UNC Health Careers site to complete the application.
payload.longDescription:
通过 UNC Health Careers ChatGPT 应用，发现你的下一个职业机会！

UNC Health 是一家综合医疗系统，由 North Carolina 州所有，总部位于 Chapel Hill。UNC Health 致力于促进健康，而不仅仅是提供医疗服务。从获得 Magnet 认证到被 Forbes Magazine 评为美国最佳雇主之一，我们很自豪地看到辛勤工作持续获得认可、表彰和赞誉。

- 决策结构的可视化概览

payload.name: Markup AI
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Markup AI reviews drafts against an organization's configured quality checks in a single call: brand voice drift, unapproved terminology, style-guide violations, hard-to-read sentences, AI-sounding phrasing, unsupported or risky claims, missing sourcing, and AI-search readiness. Users share content in ChatGPT, optionally state what they are trying to achieve, and get back which checks ran, any configuration warnings, and the flagged issues with locations, explanations, and suggested corrections. Teams can also run an explicit, named set of checks with a chosen persona, brand voice profile, style guide, or content profile, and list the checks and configurations available to their organization.
payload.longDescription: Markup AI 会通过一次调用，根据组织配置的质量检查审阅草稿：品牌语气偏差、未批准术语、风格指南违规、难读句子、听起来像 AI 的表达、缺乏依据或有风险的主张、来源缺失以及 AI 搜索适配度。用户可在 ChatGPT 中分享内容，并可选填目标；随后会收到已运行的检查项目、配置警告，以及包含位置、说明和修改建议的问题列表。团队还可以指定检查名称，选择角色、品牌语气档案、风格指南或内容档案，运行明确的一组检查，并查看组织可用的检查及配置。

payload.name: FeedBoss
payload.description: 起草并评估 LinkedIn 帖子
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: FeedBoss connects your assistant to your LinkedIn content workspace. It drafts posts in your saved voice grounded in your own knowledge base, scores a draft against a reader-reaction quality check before anything is published, saves drafts you can edit, and schedules approved drafts to publish to LinkedIn at a time you confirm each time. It also reports analytics, weekly posting-consistency streaks, and a refreshed wall of high-performing posts for inspiration.
payload.longDescription: FeedBoss 将助手连接到你的 LinkedIn 内容工作区。它会依据你保存的表达风格和自己的知识库起草帖子，并在发布前按读者反应质量标准为草稿评分。你可以保存并编辑草稿，也可以安排已批准的草稿在指定时间发布到 LinkedIn；每次发布都需由你确认。它还会提供分析数据、每周持续发帖连胜记录，以及更新后的高表现帖子墙，供你获取灵感。

payload.name: Free Marathi Biodata Maker
payload.description: 创建马拉地语婚介资料
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Create a marriage biodata (lagna biodata) in Marathi or English, directly in chat. Share a few details — name, education, family background, horoscope — and get back a polished, ready-to-share PDF within seconds.

Choose from 11 traditional templates, or generate several at once to compare side by side. No sign-up or login required, and it's completely free — the same biodata maker used on MarathiVivah.co.in, a free matrimony platform for Maharashtra's Marathi-speaking families.
payload.longDescription:
直接在聊天中用马拉地语或英语创建婚姻介绍资料（lagna biodata）。提供姓名、教育背景、家庭情况和星盘等基本信息，几秒钟内即可获得精美、可直接分享的 PDF。

可从 11 种传统模板中选择，也可以一次生成多个模板并排比较。无需注册或登录，完全免费——使用的正是 MarathiVivah.co.in 提供的同款资料生成器；该网站是面向马哈拉施特拉邦马拉地语家庭的免费婚介平台。

payload.name: CopyCharm
payload.description: 访问你的 CopyCharm 上下文
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
CopyCharm is a context workbench for saving and reusing prompts, notes, favorite clips, and curated working context.

With this ChatGPT integration, existing CopyCharm users can access selected CopyCharm items directly within ChatGPT. Instead of manually copying and pasting the same background information, project notes, or templates into each chat, users can ask ChatGPT to find and retrieve the exact context they need.

This integration only accesses items that have been intentionally made available for AI Access in CopyCharm. It does not provide ChatGPT with access to a user's broader workspace or general clipboard history.
payload.longDescription:
CopyCharm 是用于保存和重用提示词、笔记、收藏片段及精选工作上下文的工作台。

通过此 ChatGPT 集成，现有 CopyCharm 用户可直接在 ChatGPT 中访问选定的 CopyCharm 条目。无需在每次聊天中手动复制粘贴相同的背景信息、项目笔记或模板，用户可以让 ChatGPT 查找并调取所需的准确上下文。

此集成只访问你在 CopyCharm 中主动设为可供 AI 访问的条目。它不会让 ChatGPT 访问用户更广泛的工作区或通用剪贴板历史。

payload.name: Channel99
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Channel99 real time go to market intelligence connects ChatGPT directly to Channel99’s performance marketing intelligence. giving AI assistants real-time access to unified B2B marketing data and insights.. Powered by Channel99’s advanced attribution, account identification, and AI-driven analytics. The Channel99 connection enables natural-language queries that deliver accurate campaign performance, spend efficiency, audience engagement and cross channel attribution insights eliminating manual data pulls, siloed dashboards and complex API engineering. 

Marketers, analysts, and business leaders can ask ChatGPT strategic questions like “Which channels drove the most high-value engagement last quarter?” or “Where should we reallocate budget to improve pipeline efficiency?” and get precise, context-aware results powered by Channel99’s industry leading performance data. 

Developed by Channel99 a B2B marketing technology company dedicated to improving ROI, lowering acquisition costs, and bringing financial transparency to digital marketing investments.
payload.longDescription:
Channel99 实时市场进入情报将 ChatGPT 直接连接到 Channel99 的效果营销情报，为 AI 助手提供统一 B2B 营销数据和洞察的实时访问。借助先进的归因、账户识别和 AI 分析，Channel99 连接支持自然语言查询，提供准确的活动表现、支出效率、受众参与度和跨渠道归因洞察，消除手动取数、孤立仪表板和复杂 API 工程。

营销人员、分析师和业务负责人可以询问“上季度哪些渠道带来了最多高价值参与？”或“应将预算重新分配到哪里以提升管道效率？”，并获得由 Channel99 行业领先绩效数据支持的精准、结合上下文的结果。

由致力于提高 ROI、降低获客成本并提升数字营销投资财务透明度的 B2B 营销科技公司 Channel99 开发。

payload.name: Breeze
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Breeze helps teams find project information, manage cards and checklists, collaborate through comments and project discussions, track time and estimates, and safely update or remove workspace data through ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: Breeze 帮助团队查找项目信息、管理卡片和清单、通过评论和项目讨论进行协作、跟踪工时和预估，并通过 ChatGPT 安全更新或移除工作区数据。

payload.name: Rezi Resume Builder
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect your Rezi account to list and read resumes, create new resumes, update resume content, and search job listings. Tailor a resume for a specific role, revise individual sections, or build a new resume from your background. Changes are saved directly to your Rezi account.
payload.longDescription: 连接你的 Rezi 账户，即可列出和阅读简历、创建新简历、更新简历内容并搜索职位列表。针对特定职位定制简历、修改单独章节，或根据你的经历创建新简历。所有更改都会直接保存到你的 Rezi 账户。

payload.name: Find Your Great
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Query your work activity, career scores, and impact data directly in ChatGPT. Pull in Slack messages, GitHub PRs, Linear issues, meeting transcripts, and decisions to summarize your week, prep for 1-on-1s, or draft stakeholder updates — all through conversation.

Find Your Great captures your day-to-day work across platforms, scores you against your team's career framework, and surfaces behavioral patterns from your activity. 

Ask things like:
- "What did I work on this week?"
- "How are my evaluation scores trending?"
- "Draft an impact update for my manager covering the last two weeks"
- "What decisions did I make on the authentication project?"

The connection is OAuth-secured with granular scope control — you choose exactly which categories of data to share during setup.
payload.longDescription:
直接在 ChatGPT 中查询工作活动、职业评分和影响力数据。通过对话调取 Slack 消息、GitHub PR、Linear 事项、会议转录和决策记录，以总结一周工作、准备一对一（1-on-1）会议或起草利益相关方动态。

Find Your Great 会汇总你在各个平台上的日常工作，根据团队职业发展框架为你评分，并从活动中发现行为模式。

你可以这样提问：
- “我这周做了哪些工作？”
- “我的评估分数趋势如何？”
- “帮我起草一份涵盖最近两周、发给经理的影响力更新。”
- “我在身份验证项目中做了哪些决策？”

连接使用 OAuth 保护，并提供细粒度的权限范围控制——设置时由你准确选择要共享的数据类别。

payload.name: Olie Flow AI
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Olie Flow AI lets users manage their Olie workspace from ChatGPT: search and list projects, check project status and history, browse funnels and their steps, read and add project content, track funnel and step metrics, move projects between steps, and create, edit, or clone projects.
payload.longDescription: Olie Flow AI 让用户可以在 ChatGPT 中管理 Olie 工作区：搜索和列出项目、查看项目状态与历史记录、浏览漏斗及其步骤、读取和添加项目内容、跟踪漏斗与步骤指标、在步骤间移动项目，以及创建、编辑或克隆项目。

payload.name: Promptbanken
payload.description: 查找并使用提示词模板
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Promptbanken is an open, curated library of ready-to-use prompt templates for municipalities, schools, companies, associations, and individuals. Search the catalog for a task, fetch a chosen template in full, and follow a prompt package step by step — directly in ChatGPT.

The published connector is open, read-only, and requires no account or sign-in. It receives only the parameters its tools define: a search term, a role word, filters, and the id or slug of a catalog entry. Nothing else from the conversation reaches the server, and the connector publishes no write tools, so it cannot store anything. Search terms are never stored — only the length of a query is counted in anonymous usage statistics.
payload.longDescription:
Promptbanken 是面向市政机构、学校、企业、协会和个人的开放、精选提示词模板库。可搜索任务、完整获取模板并逐步使用提示词包。连接器开放且只读，无需账户或登录；只接收工具定义的搜索词、角色词、筛选器及目录条目的

ID 或 slug，不会接收对话中的其他内容，也没有写入工具，因此不能存储、修改、发布或删除任何内容。该功能为只读。需要满足相关要求。

payload.name: Slidely
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Slidely helps users create, import, review, and edit PowerPoint presentations from ChatGPT. Users can start a new deck or import an existing .pptx, choose a design system, have Slidely draft and render slides, review the proposed slides, and add the approved ones to their presentation.
payload.longDescription: Slidely 可帮助用户通过 ChatGPT 创建、导入、审阅和编辑 PowerPoint 演示文稿。用户可以新建演示文稿或导入现有 .pptx、选择设计系统、让 Slidely 起草并渲染幻灯片、审阅提议的幻灯片，并将获批的幻灯片加入演示文稿。

payload.name: NivaDesk
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
NivaDesk helps custom-order studios manage orders, customers, personal notes, tasks, schedules and financial summaries from ChatGPT. After connecting a NivaDesk workspace, users can search orders, view dashboard summaries, check permitted financial information, create personal notes and update order statuses.

It is designed for small teams and studios that work on made-to-order projects, including bespoke art, handmade products, repairs, photography, tailoring, jewellery and other client-based workflows.
payload.longDescription:
NivaDesk 帮助定制订单工作室通过 ChatGPT 管理订单、客户、私人笔记、任务、日程和财务摘要。连接 NivaDesk 工作区后，用户可以搜索订单、查看仪表板摘要、检查获准查看的财务信息、创建私人笔记并更新订单状态。

它适用于承接定制项目的小团队和工作室，包括定制艺术品、手工制品、维修、摄影、裁缝、珠宝及其他以客户为中心的工作流程。

payload.name: F-AI Contract Template Finder
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Finds links to legal document templates that match the selected filters. Covers contracts, agreements, policies, resolutions, letters, and other legal documents. 

This plugin is intended for general informational purposes and does not provide legal advice. Its developer is not a law firm, and using the plugin does not establish an attorney-client relationship. AI-generated results may contain inaccurate or outdated information. Consult a qualified legal professional before relying on or using any template.
payload.longDescription:
根据所选筛选条件查找匹配的法律文档模板链接。涵盖合同、协议、政策、决议、信函及其他法律文档。

此插件仅供一般信息参考，不提供法律建议。其开发者不是律师事务所，使用本插件不会建立律师与客户关系。AI 生成的结果可能包含不准确或过时的信息。依赖或使用任何模板前，请咨询合格的法律专业人士。

payload.name: RuleFoundry
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: RuleFoundry finds Extractions you created or that were assigned to you, shows their status and RuleFoundry link, and makes finalized artifacts from completed Extractions available as cited source material for planning, code, documents, and analysis. After you confirm the exact topic, optional description, and participant, it can create one Extraction request for you or an external email address. RuleFoundry sends the external invitation automatically. Extraction sessions still happen in RuleFoundry; the plugin cannot start, conduct, continue, complete, resend, modify, or delete them.
payload.longDescription: RuleFoundry 会查找你创建或分配给你的 Extractions，显示其状态和 RuleFoundry 链接，并将已完成 Extractions 的最终成果作为带引用的源材料，供规划、代码、文档和分析使用。确认确切主题、可选说明和参与者后，它可以为你或外部电子邮件地址创建一个 Extraction 请求。RuleFoundry 会自动发送外部邀请。Extraction 会话仍在 RuleFoundry 中进行；该插件无法启动、主持、继续、完成、重新发送、修改或删除会话。

payload.name: RiverScript
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Capture and transcribe everything you can hear on your computer with RiverScript, then bring your transcripts into your ChatGPT workflow.

RiverScript turns meetings, calls, lectures, podcasts, interviews, and any other media content into text. Record your system audio directly from any app with RiverScript Desktop client for Windows and Mac, or transcribe your audio and video files up to 50 GB and 8 hours long.

In RiverScript click the Share button for the transcript you want to bring into ChatGPT and get the link. Add it to this app. Continue working with your transcript in ChatGPT however you like. 

It works with both transcripts and their AI translations.
Transcribe with RiverScript. Work with ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription:
使用 RiverScript 捕获并转录电脑上能听到的所有内容，然后将转录文本带入你的 ChatGPT 工作流。

RiverScript 可将会议、通话、讲座、播客、访谈及其他媒体内容转成文本。你可以使用适用于 Windows 和 Mac 的 RiverScript Desktop 客户端，直接录制任意应用的系统音频；也可以转录最大 50 GB、时长 8 小时的音频和视频文件。

在 RiverScript 中，点击你想带入 ChatGPT 的转录内容旁边的 Share 按钮并获取链接。将链接添加到此应用，然后按自己的方式继续在 ChatGPT 中处理转录内容。

它同时支持转录文本及其 AI 翻译。
用 RiverScript 转录，用 ChatGPT 处理。

payload.name: LegalScout
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: LegalScout connects you with opted-in law firms and their AI associates. Search by practice area or firm name, then talk through intake in this chat—or open the firm’s associate page for voice and portal tools. Existing clients can sign in with their portal email to check matters, talk to their matter associate, add notes, and get portal links. Discovery and prospect intake work without signing in; matter tools require client authorization.
payload.longDescription: LegalScout 帮你联系已选择加入的律师事务所及其 AI 助理。按执业领域或律所名称搜索，然后在此聊天中沟通初步接洽事项，或打开律所的助理页面使用语音和门户工具。现有客户可以使用门户邮箱登录，查看案件、联系案件助理、添加备注并获取门户链接。发现律所和潜在客户初步接洽无需登录；案件工具需要客户授权。
payload.developer: General Counsel Online, Inc. d/b/a LegalScout

information.label: Developer
information.value: General Counsel Online, Inc. d/b/a LegalScout

payload.name: DocHub
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
DocHub for ChatGPT helps you handle document work — from creation to sign requests — without switching tools. Use natural language to create ready-to-use PDFs and refine them. Fill form fields, prepare and send sign requests, and track progress — all in one conversation.

No paid DocHub subscription is required to get started — ideal for individuals and teams looking for a simpler way to get documents done.
payload.longDescription:
DocHub for ChatGPT 帮助你处理文档工作，从创建到签署请求，无需切换工具。使用自然语言创建可直接使用的 PDF 并对其进行完善。填写表单字段、准备并发送签署请求、跟踪进度——全部在同一段对话中完成。

开始使用无需订阅 DocHub 付费套餐，非常适合希望更轻松处理文档的个人和团队。

payload.name: Mantic
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Mantic helps users explore probabilistic forecasts about geopolitics, business, policy, markets, technology, and culture. Search accessible questions and dashboards, inspect forecasts and their available reasoning, compare forecast history, and explore conditional scenarios and probability distributions. Save and revise question drafts, then create a question and request a one-time forecast using your Mantic account's question-creation quota. Forecast access can generate billable usage under your account settings.
payload.longDescription: Mantic 帮助用户探索有关地缘政治、商业、政策、市场、技术和文化的概率预测。搜索可访问的问题和仪表板，查看预测及可用的推理，比较预测历史，并探索条件场景和概率分布。保存并修改问题草稿，然后创建问题，使用 Mantic 账户的问题创建配额请求一次性预测。访问预测可能会根据账户设置产生计费使用量。

payload.name: CodeWords
payload.description: 构建智能体和自动化流程
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: CodeWords lets you build, deploy, and run automation workflows and websites directly from conversation. Describe what you want to automate or build, and CodeWords handles the rest - writing the code, connecting your services, deploying to the cloud, and scheduling runs. Build full-stack web apps deployed to your own URL, or backend automations that connect to Slack, Gmail, Notion, and hundreds of other services and integrations. When something breaks, pull up the logs and fix it right from the chat.
payload.longDescription: CodeWords 让你直接通过对话构建、部署并运行自动化工作流和网站。描述你想要自动化或构建的内容，CodeWords 会处理其余工作——编写代码、连接服务、部署到云端并安排运行。你可以构建部署在自有 URL 上的全栈 Web 应用，也可以构建连接 Slack、Gmail、Notion 及数百种其他服务和集成的后端自动化流程。出现故障时，可直接在聊天中调出日志并修复。

payload.name: Partoska
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Ever spent hours chasing down photos scattered across chat groups, email threads, and random cloud folders after a party? Partoska fixes that.

Create an event, share a link or QR code, and watch the photos roll in—from everyone, in one place, in full quality.

Perfect for weddings, birthday parties, team events, family reunions, corporate gatherings, sports matches, camps, and anywhere people take photos worth keeping.
payload.longDescription:
派对结束后，你是否曾花上好几个小时，在聊天群组、电子邮件往来和零散的云端文件夹中寻找照片？Partoska 可以解决这个问题。

创建活动，分享链接或 QR 码，然后看大家把照片以原画质汇集到同一个地方。

适用于婚礼、生日派对、团队活动、家庭聚会、公司聚会、体育比赛、营地活动，以及任何值得留存照片的场合。

payload.name: Izifete
payload.description: 查找附近的活动供应商
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Izifete helps you organise an event in France - a wedding, a birthday, a christening, a corporate seminar or a party - by finding verified local professionals and giving you realistic planning figures before you commit. Search by trade and by city across 15 event trades: caterer, street food, DJ, photographer, videographer, photo booth, decorator, entertainment, pastry chef, florist, equipment rental, private chef, make-up artist, hairdresser and reception venue. Every result is a real published profile on izifete.fr, shown with its city, its trades and its rating. You can also get planning figures taken from Izifete's published guides and calculators - a typical budget per trade, quantities to order, how far ahead to book each professional - and check whether a French company is officially registered from its SIRET number, using public government data. When you are ready, you can send a quote request to a professional. Izifete recaps the details and asks you to confirm first, and the request is then reviewed by the Izifete team before it reaches the professional. Nothing is sent automatically. Izifete covers France and Monaco only. When no verified professional matches a search yet, the plugin says so plainly instead of suggesting someone in another trade or another city.
payload.longDescription: Izifete 可帮助你在法国筹办活动——婚礼、生日派对、洗礼、企业研讨会或聚会——为你寻找经过核实的当地专业人士，并在你承诺之前提供切合实际的规划数据。按服务类型和城市搜索 15 类活动服务：餐饮承办、街头美食、DJ、摄影师、摄像师、照片亭、装饰、娱乐、糕点师、花艺师、设备租赁、私人厨师、化妆师、美发师和宴会场地。每条结果都是 izifete.fr 上真实发布的资料，显示所在城市、服务类型和评分。你还可以查看 Izifete 已发布指南和计算器提供的规划数据，例如各服务类别的典型预算、订购数量，以及各类专业人士需要提前多久预约；并可使用公开政府数据，通过 SIRET 编号核实法国公司是否正式注册。准备好后，你可以向专业人士发送报价请求。Izifete 会汇总详情并先请你确认，之后请求还会由 Izifete 团队审核，才会转交专业人士。任何内容都不会自动发送。Izifete 仅覆盖法国和摩纳哥。如果暂时没有符合条件的已核实专业人士，插件会明确说明，而不会推荐其他服务类别或城市的人选。

payload.name: F-AI: Contract Review
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Reviews a supplied contract for potential internal conflicts, ambiguity, missing terms, commercial or operational risks, and carefully grounded potential legal issues. The read-only interface connects each finding to the relevant contract language and lets you choose which findings to discuss. This plugin provides issue spotting and general information, not legal advice or recommendations to accept, reject, sign, or amend a contract. Its developer is not a law firm, and use does not establish an attorney-client relationship.
payload.longDescription: 检查所提供合同中可能存在的内部冲突、歧义、缺失条款、商业或运营风险，以及有合同依据的潜在法律问题。只读界面会将每项发现关联到合同中的相关措辞，并允许你选择要讨论的发现。本插件提供问题识别和一般信息，不提供法律建议，也不建议接受、拒绝、签署或修改合同。其开发者不是律师事务所，使用本插件不会建立律师与客户关系。

payload.name: PingPrompt
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: PingPrompt helps users create, search, organize, and safely edit reusable prompt artifacts from ChatGPT. The app connects ChatGPT to the user's PingPrompt workspace so prompts can be saved into projects, opened in the PingPrompt editor, versioned from the first save, and updated through validated patches that refuse missing or ambiguous edits.
payload.longDescription: PingPrompt 帮助用户在 ChatGPT 中创建、搜索、整理并安全编辑可重复使用的提示词内容。此应用将 ChatGPT 连接到用户的 PingPrompt 工作区，使提示词可以保存到项目、在 PingPrompt 编辑器中打开、从首次保存起进行版本管理，并通过经过验证的补丁进行更新；若找不到要修改的内容或匹配不明确，补丁会拒绝执行。

payload.name: Delivery Report Extractor
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Extract structured information from AI development delivery reports, including summaries, changed files, implementation items, fixes, tests, and notes. This app helps users quickly organize delivery details from engineering reports. It only analyzes provided text and does not modify code, access external systems, or perform deployment actions.
payload.longDescription: 从 AI 开发交付报告中提取结构化信息，包括摘要、变更文件、实现事项、修复、测试和备注。此应用帮助用户快速整理工程报告中的交付详情。它只分析用户提供的文本，不会修改代码、访问外部系统或执行部署操作。

payload.name: GoFloaters
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
GoFloaters makes it effortless to find professional meeting rooms and day-pass coworking spaces across India - right from your ChatGPT conversation.

Need a meeting room for 10 people in Bangalore tomorrow? A quiet desk in Chennai for the day? Just ask - GoFloaters finds available spaces instantly with pricing, amenities, and a direct booking link.

With GoFloaters in ChatGPT, you can:
Search meeting rooms by city, locality, date, and capacity
Find day-pass coworking spaces near you
Check real-time availability and pricing
Get instant booking links - no sign-up needed to browse

Skip the back-and-forth. Book your next meeting room or day pass in one conversation.
payload.longDescription:
GoFloaters 让你可以直接在 ChatGPT 对话中轻松寻找印度各地的专业会议室和日租共享办公空间。

明天需要在班加罗尔找一间可容纳 10 人的会议室？想在金奈租一个安静的办公桌用一天？只需提出需求，GoFloaters 就会立即查找可用空间，并提供价格、设施和直接预订链接。

在 ChatGPT 中使用 GoFloaters，你可以：
按城市、街区、日期和人数搜索会议室
查找附近的日租共享办公空间
查看实时空位和价格
获取即时预订链接——浏览无需注册

无需来回沟通，在一次对话中预订下次会议室或日租工位。

payload.name: Clarier
payload.description: 管理公司 AI 工具
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect ChatGPT to your Clarier workspace to review your organization’s AI tools, vendor risk reports, AI usage, requests, approvals, and compliance insights. You can prepare a new AI-tool request or tool update, review the proposed changes, and explicitly confirm before Clarier applies them. Clarier uses your existing company membership, role, and permissions.
payload.longDescription: 将 ChatGPT 连接到你的 Clarier 工作区，以查看组织的 AI 工具、供应商风险报告、AI 使用情况、请求、审批和合规洞察。你可以准备新的 AI 工具申请或工具更新，审阅拟议变更，并在 Clarier 应用变更前明确确认。Clarier 使用你现有的公司成员身份、角色和权限。

payload.name: Keypup
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Keypup is the engineering analytics platform allowing software development teams to federate data from Git (e.g., GitHub) and project management (e.g., Jira) platforms to gain visibility into their development process.

With the Keypup app in ChatGPT, you can ask questions about your engineering and product deliveries in plain language and generate fully designed reports. ChatGPT will automatically build analytical queries and leverage the Keypup data model to obtain information on volumes, cycle times, segmentation, etc.
payload.longDescription:
Keypup 是一个工程分析平台，帮助软件开发团队整合 Git（例如 GitHub）和项目管理（例如 Jira）平台的数据，以了解开发流程。

使用 ChatGPT 中的 Keypup 应用，你可以用自然语言询问工程和产品交付情况，并生成完整设计的报告。ChatGPT 会自动构建分析查询，并利用 Keypup 数据模型获取数量、周期时长、分组等信息。

payload.name: Roux
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Roux helps users launch focused conversations with teammates, customers, or stakeholders, track response progress, and bring privacy-conscious synthesized findings back into their work.
payload.longDescription: Roux 帮助用户与队友、客户或利益相关者开展有针对性的对话，跟踪回复进度，并将兼顾隐私的综合发现带回工作中。

payload.name: Nomad Helper
payload.description: 西班牙数字游民签证经验
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Find first-hand experiences from authorized Telegram chats about applying for and obtaining Spain's digital nomad visa. Nomad Helper starts fresh multilingual research for every question, follows it through completion, and returns concise findings with links to original messages. Each user can search only the chats assigned to their account. Independent service; not affiliated with Telegram.
payload.longDescription: 从获授权的 Telegram 聊天中查找有关申请和取得西班牙数字游民签证的第一手经验。Nomad Helper 会针对每个问题重新开展多语言调研，持续跟进直至完成，并附上原始消息链接，返回简明结果。每位用户只能搜索分配给自己账户的聊天。独立服务，与 Telegram 无关联。

payload.name: Safe Haven Careers
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Safe Haven Careers helps job seekers explore open roles at Safe Haven Careers. Search by job title, location, or both — the assistant surfaces relevant opportunities and lets you dig into the details before applying. Powered by Appcast.
payload.longDescription: Safe Haven Careers 帮助求职者探索 Safe Haven Careers 的开放职位。按职位名称、地点或两者一起搜索，助手会显示相关机会，并允许你在申请前深入了解详情。由 Appcast 提供支持。

payload.name: Runa
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Runa brings your authorized meeting knowledge into ChatGPT. Search meeting summaries and approved folder documents, retrieve recent or topic-matched meetings, review decisions and key takeaways, list open action items, and prepare for upcoming meetings using Runa’s latest synchronized calendar context.

Runa is read-only in ChatGPT. It cannot edit meetings, complete action items, or send messages. Results are limited by the connected user’s Runa access, workspace external-AI policy, and Runa’s public connector safety controls. A Runa account is required. Upcoming meeting info reflects Runa’s latest desktop sync and may not be live.
payload.longDescription:
Runa 将你获授权访问的会议知识带入 ChatGPT。搜索会议摘要和已批准的文件夹文档，检索近期会议或主题匹配的会议，查看决策和要点，列出未完成的行动事项，并根据 Runa 最新同步的日历背景准备即将举行的会议。

Runa 在 ChatGPT 中为只读。它无法编辑会议、完成行动事项或发送消息。结果受已连接用户的 Runa 访问权限、工作区外部 AI 政策以及 Runa 公共连接器安全控制的限制。需要 Runa 账户。即将举行的会议信息反映 Runa 最近一次桌面同步，可能不是实时数据。

payload.name: PracticPro
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: PracticPro is the CRM and operations platform contractors and service businesses use to run their full workflow: clients and leads, estimates, contracts with electronic signatures, invoices and payments, phone calls, SMS, email, scheduling, and custom reports. Inside ChatGPT, every part of that workflow runs in plain English. Examples: "send the Carmichael estimate for signature", "record a $5,000 deposit from Rachel Kim", "text Tony Vasquez to confirm tomorrow's install", "draft a $4,200 invoice for the kitchen demo", or "show jobs with unpaid balances over $10K". Every action executes against your live PracticPro account with your existing permissions.
payload.longDescription: PracticPro 是承包商和服务企业用于管理完整工作流的 CRM 与运营平台，涵盖客户和潜客、报价、电子签名合同、发票和付款、电话、短信、电子邮件、排程及自定义报告。在 ChatGPT 中，整个工作流都可用自然语言运行，例如发送报价供签署、记录 5,000 美元定金、短信确认明日安装、起草 4,200 美元厨房拆除发票，或显示未付余额超过 10,000 美元的工作。每项操作都会使用您现有权限，直接在实时 PracticPro 账户中执行。执行操作前请确认。

payload.name: Sunate
payload.description: 在 ChatGPT 中管理 CRM
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect your Sunate workspace to ChatGPT and Codex to manage everyday CRM work in natural language. Find and update contacts, leads, deals, tasks, pipelines, assignments, and private quote drafts; check roof reports; and prepare lead-generation requests. Access follows each member's Sunate permissions, and sensitive actions require confirmation. A Sunate account with the OpenAI integration enabled is required.
payload.longDescription: 将 Sunate 工作区连接到 ChatGPT 和 Codex，通过自然语言处理日常 CRM 工作。查找和更新联系人、潜在客户、交易、任务、销售管道、分配事项和私人报价草稿；查看屋顶报告；并准备潜在客户开发请求。访问权限遵循每位成员在 Sunate 中的权限，敏感操作需要确认。使用此功能需要 Sunate 账户，并启用 OpenAI 集成。

payload.name: Talonic
payload.description: 提取数据并与文档对话

Talonic helps users turn documents such as PDFs, scans, invoices, contracts, certificates, statements, and forms into schema-validated JSON. 
Users can extract structured fields, convert documents to markdown, search and filter their Talonic workspace, manage reusable extraction schemas, check document status, request browser upload links, and view credit balance information.
payload.longDescription:
Talonic 帮助用户将 PDF、扫描件、发票、合同、证书、对账单和表单等文档转换为经过架构验证的 JSON。
用户可以提取结构化字段、将文档转换为 Markdown、搜索和筛选 Talonic 工作区、管理可重复使用的提取架构、查看文档状态、请求浏览器上传链接，并查看额度余额信息。

payload.name: tugesto
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: tugesto es el asistente para evolucionar la gestión de tu empresa: nóminas, RRHH, registro horario, portal del empleado, facturación, contabilidad, fiscalidad y cumplimiento legal en un mismo entorno. Desde ChatGPT, te ayuda a resolver dudas, entender procesos y descubrir cómo automatizar tareas, reducir errores y centralizar la operativa diaria con una solución SaaS pensada para empresas, autónomos, gestorías y asesorías.

payload.name: Cinch
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Cinch helps users work with their project management data in ChatGPT by listing companies and projects, inspecting tasks and comments, creating project work, updating task fields, and adding task comments.
payload.longDescription: Cinch 帮助用户在 ChatGPT 中处理项目管理数据，包括列出公司和项目、查看任务与评论、创建项目工作、更新任务字段以及添加任务评论。

payload.name: Socra Cortex
payload.description: 别再对 AI 重复说明
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Socra Cortex helps people and teams stop repeating the same preferences, requirements, and decisions to ChatGPT and Codex. It keeps that knowledge and its reasons in a single source of truth that agents can retrieve before acting, across conversations and tools.

Modules record what should be and why, with a responsible owner and version history. Dependencies link the knowledge required to understand it. Flash loads the relevant Module and all its Dependencies, foundations first and each Module once.

Team members can own different subjects while their knowledge works together. For example, a product requirement Module created in ChatGPT can depend on architecture and security Modules maintained by their owners. Codex can Flash that requirement before implementing it and receive those decisions together.

As conversations and work reveal new knowledge, agents propose changes to existing Modules, so the knowledge always stays up to date. The suggested workflow asks them to show exact Before and After content and Dependencies for the owner's approval before saving. Updates become available on later Flashes, while version history preserves earlier knowledge and records changes.

Issues connect tasks to the Modules governing them, with assignees, work dependencies, comments, and evidence. Inboxes show unblocked work to its responsible person or agent; completed Issues preserve the outcome and history.

People and teams own the knowledge in their Socra Account, with Module permissions for people and groups. Review Modules, the knowledge map, and work at https://cortex.socra.com. Connect ChatGPT, Codex, or any other AI provider to that same Account with Cortex access.

Setup and agent instructions: https://workspace.socra.com/docs/cortex/installation.md
payload.longDescription:
Socra Cortex 帮助个人和团队不必一遍遍向 ChatGPT 和 Codex 重复相同的偏好、要求和决策。它将这些知识及其原因保存在统一的事实来源中，供智能体在不同对话和工具中采取行动前检索。

Modules 记录应该做什么以及原因，并包含责任人和版本历史。Dependencies 用于关联理解这些知识所必需的信息。Flash 会先加载基础内容，再加载相关 Module 及其全部 Dependencies，每个 Module 只加载一次。

团队成员可以分别负责不同主题，同时让各自的知识协同工作。例如，在 ChatGPT 中创建的产品需求 Module 可以依赖由相应负责人维护的架构和安全 Modules。Codex 在实施该需求前可以 Flash 它，并一并获得这些决策。

随着对话和工作产生新知识，智能体会提议修改现有 Modules，让知识始终保持最新。建议的工作流程会要求它们在保存前展示精确的修改前后内容和 Dependencies，供负责人审批。更新会在后续 Flash 时生效，而版本历史会保留早期知识并记录变更。

Issues 将任务与其所依据的 Modules 关联起来，并包含受指派人、工作依赖、评论和证据。收件箱会向相应负责人或智能体显示没有阻塞的工作；已完成的 Issues 会保留结果和历史记录。

个人和团队在自己的 Socra Account 中拥有这些知识，并可为人员和群组设置 Module 权限。请访问 https://cortex.socra.com. 查看 Modules、知识地图和工作情况。你可以将 ChatGPT、Codex 或任何其他 AI 服务商连接到具有 Cortex 访问权限的同一 Account。

设置和智能体说明：https://workspace.socra.com/docs/cortex/installation.md

payload.name: Curaiz Remote Jobs
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Find fresh remote jobs matched to your experience, goals, and eligible locations. Describe the work you want and where you can legally work; Curaiz searches current remote postings and returns the strongest candidates with role, company, applicant locations, salary when stated, and a direct listing link. Ask for full details to review requirements, company context, and the application URL. Curaiz is read-only and never applies, sends messages, or changes data on your behalf.
payload.longDescription: 根据你的经验、目标和符合条件的工作地点，查找最新的远程职位。描述你想做的工作以及你在法律上可以工作的地点；Curaiz 会搜索当前远程职位，并返回最匹配的机会，包括职位、公司、允许申请者所在地点、已注明的薪资和职位直达链接。你可以询问完整详情，以查看要求、公司背景和申请网址。Curaiz 仅提供只读功能，绝不会代你申请、发送消息或更改数据。

payload.name: Hero by Vivun
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Meet Hero, your AI teammate for Sales. Hero can join your calls, write your follow-ups, research accounts, and help you keep every deal moving. This connector provides ChatGPT read-only access to your Hero data so you can get Hero’s insights wherever you work best. 

What you can do in ChatGPT with the Hero connector
• Search meeting transcripts by keyword, meaning, date range, or workspace to  pull the full transcript with per-speaker segments.
• Find and read Hero-generated artifacts like call summaries, account research, saved notes, and uploaded files.
• Browse and revisit your Hero conversation threads.
• Get a list of your Workspaces (accounts and deals) to scope your work. 

Example prompts
• “Summarize my calls with Acme this month, and draft a follow-up email.”
• “Can you tell me what objections came up during yesterday’s demo with Hooli?” 
• “Pull the account research Hero wrote for Globex and turn it into a one-pager.”
• “Find every call where pricing came up this quarter.”

Security and Privacy
• Sign in with secure OAuth: no passwords or API keys to manage.
• Strictly read-only: ChatGPT can retrieve your Hero data but cannot create, modify, or delete anything.
• Scoped to your own account: ChatGPT only sees data you already have access to in Hero
• Requires a Hero account: get started at meethero.ai.
payload.longDescription:
认识你的 AI 销售队友 Hero。Hero 可以加入通话、撰写跟进内容、研究客户账户并帮助推进每笔交易。此连接器向 ChatGPT 提供对 Hero 数据的只读访问，让你在方便的工作环境中获取 Hero 洞察。

通过 ChatGPT 中的 Hero 连接器，你可以：
• 按关键词、含义、日期范围或工作区搜索会议转录文本，并获取带逐位发言内容的完整转录。
• 查找并阅读 Hero 生成的内容，例如通话摘要、客户账户研究、已保存笔记和上传文件。
• 浏览并重新查看 Hero 对话线程。
• 获取工作区（客户账户和交易）列表，以限定工作范围。

示例提示：
•“总结我本月与 Acme 的通话，并起草一封跟进邮件。”
•“昨天与 Hooli 的演示中出现了哪些异议？”
•“调出 Hero 为 Globex 撰写的客户研究，并整理成单页概览。”
•“找出本季度所有提到定价的通话。”

安全与隐私：
• 使用安全的 OAuth 登录：无需管理密码或 API 密钥。
• 严格只读：ChatGPT 可以检索 Hero 数据，但不能创建、修改或删除任何内容。
• 仅限本人账号范围：ChatGPT 只能查看你在 Hero 中已有权限访问的数据。
• 需要 Hero 账号：请访问 meethero.ai 开始使用。

payload.name: Namp

payload.longDescription: Namp MCP 帮助已通过身份验证的用户查找项目、笔记、备忘录、会议纪要、看板、成员和文件；还可以通过 ChatGPT 创建或更新私人项目工作区内容，以及上传项目文件。

payload.name: LASEC
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
LASEC vous aide à structurer et piloter votre gouvernance cyber au même endroit : analyses de risques, audits, registres, mesures de sécurité, plans d’actions et synthèses.

Retrouvez facilement tout ce qui a été produit dans l’application LASEC, complétez vos travaux et gardez une vision claire de votre niveau de sécurité dans la durée.

LASEC 帮助你在同一处构建并管理网络安全治理：风险分析、审计、登记册、安全措施、行动计划和总结。

payload.name: JobLoop

payload.longDescription: 将 JobLoop 连接到 ChatGPT，更高效地管理求职流程。在 JobLoop 工作区中搜索已保存的申请、添加已确认的职位、创建定制简历版本、保存 STAR 经历，并记录面试复盘。

payload.name: Flatre

Built for day-to-day brokerage work, Flatre connects with tools like email, calendars, MLS, e-signature, accounting, and storage. Its approval-first AI can help draft communications, review documents, organize intake, and surface next steps, giving teams clearer handoffs and fewer missed details.
payload.longDescription:

以审批为先，协助起草沟通和整理下一步。

payload.name: Jibble
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Jibble is the highest-rated time tracking and attendance software according to independent user reviews. With free-forever time tracking for unlimited users, teams can track hours, attendance, projects, time off, and more.

Connect Jibble to ChatGPT and turn your workforce data into instant answers, insights, and actions. Ask how many hours your team worked, where time is being spent, who's working overtime, how attendance is trending, or how many hours have been logged to a project. ChatGPT can analyze your Jibble data, summarize findings, compare results, and surface useful patterns — without having to dig through reports.

You can also take action directly from the conversation: clock in or out, correct missed punches, manage time off, and generate reports.

Whether you're checking a single person's hours or looking for broader workforce trends, Jibble + ChatGPT gives you a faster way to ask questions, understand your data, and get things done.
payload.longDescription:
根据独立用户评价，Jibble 是评分最高的工时追踪和出勤软件。它永久免费为不限数量的用户提供工时追踪，团队可追踪工时、出勤、项目、休假等信息。

将 Jibble 连接到 ChatGPT，即可把员工数据转化为即时答案、洞察和操作。你可以询问团队工作了多少小时、时间花在哪里、谁在加班、出勤趋势如何，或某个项目记录了多少工时。ChatGPT 可以分析你的 Jibble 数据、总结发现、比较结果并找出有用规律，无需翻查报告。

你还可以直接在对话中执行操作：上下班打卡、更正漏打卡记录、管理员工休假并生成报告。

无论你是查看某个人的工时，还是了解更广泛的员工趋势，Jibble + ChatGPT 都能让你更快地提问、理解数据并完成工作。

payload.name: Softr
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Softr is an AI app builder that turns your data into apps, portals, and automations. This connector gives ChatGPT direct access to your Softr workspace, so you can go from an idea to a working, published app in a single conversation.

Databases: create tables and the fields to match your project, structure and import records, and browse data sources you have already connected.

Applications: generate an app on top of your data, add and arrange pages and blocks, configure sign-up and login, set user groups and page permissions, and manage app users. Extend any page with a custom code block that ChatGPT writes for you, with every version saved so you can roll back.

Workflows: build multi-step automations with triggers, actions, and branching logic, test each step against real data, and publish when it works.

ChatGPT can preview the result and, when you ask it to, publish live. Everything it makes appears in Softr Studio exactly like work done by hand, so you and your team keep editing in the visual builder afterward - nothing is locked into the chat.

Day to day, ChatGPT can also work with your data directly: search, filter, and aggregate records, and create or update them in bulk.

Every action runs with your own permissions, and you choose the access level per workspace when you connect: read-only, edit, or full access.
payload.longDescription:
Softr 是一款 AI 应用构建工具，可将你的数据转化为应用、门户和自动化流程。此连接器让 ChatGPT 直接访问你的 Softr 工作区，因此你可以在一次对话中从创意做到可运行并已发布的应用。

数据库：创建符合项目需求的表和字段、整理并导入记录，以及浏览已连接的数据源。

应用：基于数据生成应用，添加并排列页面和区块，配置注册和登录、设置用户组和页面权限，并管理应用用户。还可使用 ChatGPT 编写的自定义代码区块扩展任意页面，每个版本都会保存，以便回滚。

工作流：通过触发器、操作和分支逻辑构建多步骤自动化流程，针对真实数据测试每个步骤，并在运行正常后发布。

ChatGPT 可以预览结果，并在你提出要求时将其正式发布。它创建的所有内容都会像手动制作的一样出现在 Softr Studio 中，之后你和团队仍可在可视化构建器中编辑——内容不会被锁定在聊天里。

日常使用时，ChatGPT 还可以直接处理你的数据：搜索、筛选和汇总记录，并批量创建或更新记录。

每项操作都使用你自己的权限。连接时，你可以为每个工作区选择访问级别：只读、编辑或完全访问。

payload.name: Sydium
payload.description: 用自己的风格安排帖子
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Sydium for ChatGPT connects your existing Sydium workspace - it requires an active plan or trial, and connecting doesn't start one (plans are managed at sydium.com). Once connected, ChatGPT can draft captions the way you actually write (learned from what you have already published), schedule or publish to up to ten platforms (Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, X, Facebook, Pinterest, Bluesky, Threads, Mastodon), check how posts performed, pull today's content idea, and manage the upcoming queue - edit, reschedule, or cancel anything still scheduled. Agencies can act for individual clients with the same team-scoped permissions as the Sydium app. Publishing actions are explicit: ChatGPT confirms before anything lands on a public feed.
payload.longDescription: ChatGPT 版 Sydium 可连接你现有的 Sydium 工作区——使用需要有效订阅方案或试用期，连接本身不会自动开通方案（方案由 sydium.com 管理）。连接后，ChatGPT 可以按照你一贯的写作风格起草文案（根据你已发布的内容学习），安排或发布到最多十个平台（Instagram、TikTok、YouTube、LinkedIn、X、Facebook、Pinterest、Bluesky、Threads、Mastodon），查看帖子表现、获取今日内容灵感，并管理即将发布的队列——编辑、重新安排或取消仍处于排期中的内容。代理机构可以代表各个客户执行操作，权限范围与 Sydium 应用中的团队权限一致。发布操作需要明确确认：ChatGPT 会在内容发布到公开动态前征求确认。

payload.name: Memova.ai
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Memova helps users work with their own meeting notes in ChatGPT and Codex. The app can search and summarize Memova notes and transcripts, review action items, inspect and run private automation tasks with guarded progress writes, and help users set up their own LLM Wiki-style knowledge base.
payload.longDescription: Memova 帮助用户在 ChatGPT 和 Codex 中处理自己的会议笔记。该应用可以搜索并总结 Memova 笔记和转录内容、查看行动项、检查并运行带有受控进度写入的私人自动化任务，还能协助用户建立自己的 LLM Wiki 式知识库。

payload.name: FilesAnywhere
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Use this tool to interact with files stored in FilesAnywhere through natural language queries. It enables users to search, summarize, compare, and extract information from documents without manually reviewing each file. This tool is appropriate when working with stored documents to quickly locate key details, analyze content, or generate insights directly from file data.
payload.longDescription: 通过自然语言查询，与 FilesAnywhere 中存储的文件互动。无需手动逐份查看文档，即可搜索、总结、比较和提取信息。此工具适用于快速定位文件、分析文档或直接在 ChatGPT 中从存储内容提取见解。

payload.name: Cribly
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Agentic Home Inventory and Organization Memory
payload.longDescription: 智能家居物品清单与整理记忆

payload.name: Steady
payload.summaryOriginal: Stay in sync with your team
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Steady brings complete context about what's going on at work into your ChatGPT workflows. It continuously distills plans, progress, and activity across your tools and teams — so every conversation starts with the full story instead of a blank slate. Catch up on what you missed, ask questions about projects and goals, or post updates directly from ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: Steady 将工作中发生事项的完整背景带入你的 ChatGPT 工作流。它持续汇总你使用的工具和团队中的计划、进展与活动，让每次对话都从完整背景开始，而非一无所知。了解错过的事项、询问项目和目标，或直接通过 ChatGPT 发布更新。

payload.name: Clio
payload.description: 在 Clio 中访问 Vincent
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Bring Vincent’s legal intelligence into Codex. Research the law, analyze dockets and develop case strategy with access to Clio Library and Clio Docket, with citations back to the underlying sources. Your matters and firm data stay securely governed in Clio.
payload.longDescription: 将 Vincent 的法律智能引入 Codex。借助 Clio Library 和 Clio Docket 研究法律、分析案卷并制定案件策略，同时获得指向底层来源的引文。你的案件和律所数据仍由 Clio 安全管理。

payload.name: Axiomyx Personal
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect ChatGPT and Codex to evidence from files you select and index in Axiomyx Personal. Search your evidence, retrieve relevant passages, and check their source provenance. Access is read-only: this plugin does not modify your source files or run commands. Axiomyx Personal must be installed, running, online, and connected. You approve the connection in the desktop app. Your index remains on your computer; requested evidence is transmitted through an authenticated relay to the AI service you connect.
payload.longDescription: 将 ChatGPT 和 Codex 连接到你在 Axiomyx Personal 中选择并建立索引的文件证据。搜索证据、获取相关段落，并核查来源出处。访问为只读：此插件不会修改源文件或运行命令。Axiomyx Personal 必须已安装、正在运行、在线且已连接。你在桌面应用中批准连接。索引留在你的计算机上；请求的证据通过经过认证的中继传输到你连接的AI服务。

payload.name: Discipline Rewards (D/R)
payload.description: 随处规划，在 D/R 中执行
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Want to build better habits, stay consistent with goals, improve your health, strengthen your routines, or create a plan for personal growth? ChatGPT can help you brainstorm ideas, structure goals, build habit systems, and create accountability plans tailored to what you're trying to achieve.

When you're ready, ChatGPT can send that plan to Discipline Rewards as a pending draft for review. Nothing is added automatically. Every plan must be reviewed and approved inside Discipline Rewards before habits, goals, or accountability commitments are created.

Discipline Rewards helps turn good intentions into consistent action. Use ChatGPT to think through the plan, then use Discipline Rewards to review, approve, and execute it.

This integration is designed to keep planning flexible while keeping execution intentional. Build plans in ChatGPT, then follow through in Discipline Rewards.
payload.longDescription:
想养成更好的习惯、坚持目标、改善健康、加强日常规律，或制定个人成长计划？ChatGPT 可以帮你构思想法、梳理目标、建立习惯体系，并根据你的目标制定问责计划。

准备好后，ChatGPT 可以将计划发送到 Discipline Rewards，作为待审核草稿。内容不会自动添加。必须在 Discipline Rewards 中审查并批准每项计划，之后才会创建习惯、目标或问责承诺。

Discipline Rewards 帮助你将良好意愿转化为持续行动。先用 ChatGPT 梳理计划，再用 Discipline Rewards 审核、批准并执行。

此集成旨在让规划保持灵活，同时确保执行经过慎重确认。在 ChatGPT 中制定计划，再通过 Discipline Rewards 跟进落实。

payload.name: TrackTogether
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: TrackTogether helps people create trackers, manage checklist tasks, collaborate with friends, and follow progress through ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: TrackTogether 帮助用户通过 ChatGPT 创建追踪器、管理清单任务、与朋友协作并跟进进度。
